summary: Iteration 6 — Trips calendar, reservations, reorders, receipts, and product trace tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_trips.py pass covering (a) POST /api/trips as driller with validated YYYY-MM-DD (end<start -> 400, bad pattern -> 422), (b) GET /api/trips scoping — driller sees only own trips, QLD manager sees only warehouse_id=QLD; start/end overlap filter works, (c) GET /api/trips/{id} enriches each item with on_hand/reserved_other/available/short and returns short_lines + reorders; available == max(0, on_hand - reserved_other), (d) role gate — driller cannot approve (403), manager approve -> status=approved, re-approve -> 409, (e) reservations — a second pending trip for the same product sees reserved_other >= 2 from the previously approved trip (RESERVING = approved|prepared), (f) prepare -> status=prepared, issue -> creates linked stock_request (type=take, status=approved, zoho_mode=mock, zoho_txn_id MOCK-ADJ-*, client_ref=trip-<id>), trip.status=issued, issued_request_id set; put on an issued trip returns 409, (g) issue with insufficient stock (qty=9999) -> 400 'Not enough … on hand; reorder or reduce the trip', (h) POST /api/trips/{id}/reorder with empty body creates a RO- reorder from shortages with trip_id/trip_number/needed_by, (i) POST /api/reorders manual + GET /api/reorders?status=open returns created id; POST /api/reorders/{id}/status ordered works, POST /api/receipts with reorder_id increments received and flips status to 'received' when complete; cancelling a received reorder -> 409, (j) GET /api/products/{pid}/trace returns {product, movements, reservations, reorders}; manager scope limits movements to warehouse_id=QLD; unknown pid -> 404; driller cancel own pending trip -> 200. Frontend (390x844 mobile): logged in as qld.manager and opened /trips -> [trips-screen] renders, month label 'October 2026', prev/next month working ('November 2026'), day grid with 42 cells and status filter chips (All/Pending/Approved/Prepared/Issued) visible; opened /reorders as manager -> page renders with Open/Ordered/Received/All chip filters; opened /history -> [history-screen] renders with search input, typed 'HQ' triggered search; logged in as driller jake and opened /trips/new -> [trip-form-screen] renders with Warehouse chips (QLD/NSW), Driller chip ('Jake Turner' preselected), Rig chip row, Start/End YYYY-MM-DD fields, Site field, Items needed section with search, and [trip-submit-button] visible. No red screen, no deprecated expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch references in trips/reorders/history code paths. The 401 console entries during initial route load are expected — components mount before the auth token hydrates and the api() helper retries after login completes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 1707 lines (trips/reorders/trace adds ~300). Reserved aggregation (reserved_qty, 830-834) is one query per item inside enrich_trip — fine at current scale but should move to a single $facet aggregation if trips grow to thousands.

server.py:986 — issue_trip raises 400 'Not enough {sku} on hand ({on_hand}); reorder or reduce the trip' AFTER appending some lines to the local `lines` list but BEFORE inserting into db.stock_requests, so the partial allocation is correctly discarded. Good.
server.py:994-998 — issue_trip is idempotent via client_ref='trip-<id>' + unique index db.stock_requests.client_ref. If a prior request existed, it reuses its rid. Nice safety net.

server.py:710-711 — receipt handler sets reorder status to 'received' when ALL lines are >= their qty, but silently keeps status='open' when the receipt only partially fills; the history push labels it 'partial' though. Consider also updating reorders.status to 'partial' so the UI can show it. Minor UX gap.

server.py:1092 — product_trace running-balance uses `bal[w] = bal[w] - m['delta']` while walking newest-first. Correct arithmetic (balance_after is the balance JUST AFTER the movement; subtracting delta gives balance_before, which becomes the next-older entry's balance_after). Verified matches movement ordering.
server.py:1096 — trace reservations filter includes 'pending' alongside RESERVING. Review spec says 'pending/approved/prepared' trips — matches.

trips/new.tsx:46 — search uses /products?warehouse_id=X&q=... (debounced via useApi) but `/products` endpoint doesn't actually filter by q in the backend based on quick inspection — search still works client-side via the pre-fetched list. If product counts grow large, add server-side q handling.
trips/index.tsx:52 — ScrollView without KeyboardAvoidingView is fine for a calendar; no input fields on this screen. OK.
trips/[id].tsx handles manager approve/reject/prepare/issue + driller edit/cancel; file is 136 lines and remains readable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — trip calendar, prev/next, filter chips, trip form, reorders filters, history search all render and interact correctly

seed_data_creation: Side-effects left in DB from this run (small, intentional, Zoho was mock so no real adjustments): (1) one 'issued' trip for CS-HQ-3M qty=2 (test_13); the matching stock_request SR-<id> is approved with zoho_mode=mock, zoho_txn_id=MOCK-ADJ-* — 2 units of CS-HQ-3M were deducted from QLD stock (27 -> 25). This is unavoidable because the review spec explicitly asks to verify issue -> stock decreases. (2) one received reorder RO-<id> for the same product qty=2 brought QLD stock back up by 2 (zoho mock). Net stock change: 0. (3) Three cancelled trips (edit-rejected date range, big-qty shortage trip after it was approved then had reorder raised, and a bonus driller-cancel-own test). All TEST-supplier reorders were received or cancelled by the autouse cleanup. (4) One open reorder for the big-qty shortage trip remains (RO-* for 9997 units CS-HQ-3M, supplier=''). This is harmless (open status) but main agent may want to cancel it along with the issued trip's residue if desired. Verified post-run: Zoho mode='mock' (unchanged, as instructed), selected_mode='mock', connected=true, has_refresh_token=true, organization_id=7007711688 — NO zoho write endpoints called, NO Connect/Disconnect/Import performed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration6_trips.py — runs with `pytest -o addopts=''` to disable xdist (shared module-level state via _created_trip_ids list ordering). testIDs confirmed working on mobile 390x844: trips-screen, trips-new-button, trips-prev-month, trips-next-month, trips-month-label, trips-day-<YYYY-MM-DD>, trips-filter-<status>, trip-card-<number>, trip-form-screen, trip-wh-<QLD|NSW>, trip-driller-<name>, trip-rig-<number>, trip-start-input, trip-end-input, trip-site-input, trip-notes-input, trip-search-input, trip-item-<sku>, trip-item-remove-<sku>, trip-item-qty-<sku>, trip-kit-<id>, trip-add-<sku>, trip-did-you-mean, trip-submit-button, history-screen, history-search-input, reorder-card-<number> (list), zoho-screen. The seeded TR-...-4D9E trip for DB-HQ-001 qty 500 (approved) that main agent mentioned is still intact and reservation checks accounted for it by routing tests to a different product (CS-HQ-3M). Issue endpoint requires the trip be in RESERVING = ['approved','prepared'] and goes zoho-first-then-stock via approve_request so Zoho mock keeps everything atomic. receipt handler sets status='received' only when ALL lines filled — partial receipts keep status='open' with 'partial' history note (see critical_code_review_comments #4).
rca_of_issue: No bug to RCA this iteration — this was a greenfield feature validation. One minor code-review nit worth considering: /api/receipts should update reorder.status to 'partial' when some lines are received but not all, so the UI can distinguish 'open-but-progressing' from 'open-nothing-received'. Currently it only writes 'partial' into history. Non-blocking.
